item.title: [data-breach] Navia data breach impacts nearly 2.7 Million people
item.description: Navia Benefit Solutions data breach exposed 2.7M people after attackers accessed systems from December 2025 to January 2026. Navia Benefit Solutions disclosed a data breach affecting 2,697,540 individuals.
